name: FLUX DETAIL ENHANCER [Lorafy]
description: Lorafys Detail Enhancer for FLUX Create even better outputs with Lorafys Detail Enhancer for FLUX. This LoRA is supposed to create more detailed outputs while using FLUX. To activate the LoRA simply write lorafy_de This LoRA was trained on 32 Image Pairs containing a base image and an enhanced version for a total of 64 images. The dataset ranges from simple woman/man images to mythical beings to abstract art. For an optimal output use the LoRA with a weight of 0.8 up to 1 . If you like my models please support me!
